overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to hold a regular meeting on November 9, 2026, to address multiple action items including facility usage fees, course approvals in technology education, student fees for the upcoming school year, and a boys hockey co-op discussion. The agenda also included routine consent items covering staffing changes, meeting minutes, budget reports, and donations.

agenda.item: Appointments (Additional Staff, Replacement Staff, Contract Increases)
Minutes: Regular Session of October 12, 2026; Closed Session of October 21, 2026; Closed II Session of October 21, 2026; and Special Session of October 26, 2026
Payment of Bills/Budget Status and Investment Report
Board Member Professional Growth & Development Report

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to recognize Maine Elementary for excellence in action as part of the meeting's opening business.

Assistant Superintendent Dr. Elizabeth Channel was scheduled to present a written summary report of all legal counsel expenses incurred during the first quarter of 2026-2027, broken down by law firm and by type of legal advice sought. This presentation was estimated to take 2 minutes and required no action.
The board was scheduled to discuss a boys hockey co-op arrangement at a board member's request. This discussion was expected to take approximately 10 minutes and possible action was anticipated.

Dr. Elizabeth Channel, Assistant Superintendent of Operations, was scheduled to present the first phase of updates to the Facility Usage Fee Schedule for board consideration. Action was requested on this item, with an estimated presentation time of 2 minutes.

Director of Secondary Education Dr. Jon Tomski was scheduled to present adjustments to the Technology Education programming for course approval. The board was expected to request action on these adjustments, with an estimated presentation time of 2 minutes.

CTE Coordinator Jon Winter was scheduled to give a brief update on the District ACP plan, including a student success story. Action was requested on this item, with an estimated presentation time of 2 minutes.

The board was scheduled to consider the annual student fees for the 2027-2028 school year, following a presentation at the October Committee of the Whole meeting. Action was requested for approval, with an estimated presentation time of 2 minutes.

Director of Secondary Education Dr. Jon Tomski was scheduled to share an update on the progress of exploring the potential Hmong Language offering as a new course option. The presentation was estimated to take 2 minutes.

publicComment: A public and student comment period was scheduled as part of the agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to approve the consent agenda including appointments, separations, leaves of absence, retirements, meeting minutes, budget status reports, and donations
Action was requested for approval of updates to the Facility Usage Fee Schedule
Action was requested for approval of course adjustments in Technology Education programming
Action was requested regarding the District ACP Plan
Action was requested for approval of annual student fees for the 2027-2028 school year
Board was expected to consider possible action on the boys hockey co-op discussion
title: Regular Meeting - 2026-11-09
